story.heading: A Skippack garden center that still feels like a shop
paragraphs: Floral and Hardy is a garden center and gift shop in Skippack Village. You browse plants, you duck into gifts, and you can climb to the succulent bar.
Weekdays run 8 to 4. Call 610-584-0797 if you need design, or open the online shop when you already know the plant.
Call 610-584-0797. Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: A visit with dirt on the floor.
items: Walk the garden center for herbs, veggies, and whatever's in season.
Build a succulent upstairs, or ask about design if the yard needs a plan.
The gift shop and online shop catch the days you aren't planting.

feature.heading: The succulent bar is the reason people linger
feature.text: You don't have to leave with a finished pot. The bar is set up so you pick the vessel, the plant, and the topping, then take it home. The garden center carries herbs, veggies, and the plants you actually came to Skippack to find.
